senses.gloss: m. (זְוֵי; cmp. זוּג, fr. זָוַג) pair, set; change of clothes; scissors (corresp. to, and interchanging with זוֹגָא).
units: <cite ref="Megillah 16a:9">Meg. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>לית לי זווא</he> Ms. M. I have no scissors; <he>אתא אליהו ושדא ליה ז׳</he> Elijah came and dropped a pair of scissors; (ed. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זוזא</he></cite>, a. entirely differ. vers.; Ar. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זווא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 116a:8">B. Mets. 116ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>זוגא דסרבלי</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>זוזי</he>, Ms. F. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זוזא</he></cite>; Ar. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זווא</he></cite>) scissors for shearing shaggy woolen stuff; <cite ref="Bava Batra 52a">B. Bath. 52ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 46b">Shebu. 46ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75b:12">Ab. Zar. 75ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="G00138"><he>זוזא</he></cite> (Ar. <he>זוו׳</he>).

<cite ref="Taanit 21b">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>זווא דרבנן</he> ed. Pes. a. oth. (oth. ed. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זוזא</he></cite>, oth. <cite ref="G00124"><he>זוגא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100) a delegation of scholars.

<cite ref="Megillah 7a">Meg. 7ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 4b">Succ. 4ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 54b:20">Sabb. 54ᵇ</cite> (an editorial gloss) <he>בכוליה סדר מועד כל כי האי זווא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="G00124"><he>זוגא</he></cite>) in the entire Order of Moëd, wherever this combination of authorities appears, some take out R. Joh. and insert R. Jon.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 22b:7">Ber. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>חד מהאי זווא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="G00124"><he>זוגא</he></cite>) one of the first combination of scholars, and one of the second combination.—Pl. (<he>זוּזֵי</he>) <he>זָוֵוי</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 71a">Keth. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ ז׳ קתני</he> Ar. (ed. <he>זוגי</he>) they are arranged in couples (two scholars for the one opinion and two for the other).
<cite ref="Pesachim 111a">Pes. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>הנהו ז׳ בכשפים עסיקן</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ודאי וכ׳</he>) these are of the couples engaged in sorcery.
Erub. 97ᵃ צבתים ז׳ ז׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) ts’vathim (Mish.

ib. X, 1) means bundles of one set (of T’fillin) each. Ib. 37ᵃ עולא זוזי זוזי קתני ed. (Ms. M. זווי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) Ula arranges the authorities quoted in couples (two on each side, v. supra).

<cite ref="Shabbat 129b:5">Sabb. 129ᵇ</cite> <he>דקיימא מאדים בז׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>בזוּזַיָּה</he>, Ms. O. <he>בזוזי</he>, Tosaf. to <cite ref="Eruvin 56a">Erub. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>בזוגי</he>) when the planet Mars rules at even-numbered hours of the day.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:3:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>רחוץ בז׳ אוחרי</he> bathe in another suit of clothes.—
Sabb. 19ᵇ כרכי דזוזי (Ms. O. כריכי דזוגי) coupled (hinged) mattings used for roof-like protections for goods; [Var. quoted in Rashi: זִיוֵי meaning ships;] ib. 156ᵇ (where Rashi has זווי ships).
